summary:
I have investigated the codebase and run `test.sh`, which revealed a timing side-channel vulnerability in `compareHashes` located in `app/auth/compare.go` due to its use of the `==` operator rather than a constant-time comparison. 

I updated `compareHashes` to use `crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare`, which resolves the vulnerability.

Running `test.sh` again confirms that all security tests now pass and the authentication logic is secure against timing attacks. Please let me know if you need anything else!
